summary: Ondas Inc. filed an 8-K regarding a prospectus supplement covering the resale of 3,126,979 shares of common stock by certain stockholders. These shares were previously issued in connection with the acquisitions of Omnisys Ltd. (3,125,000 shares) and World View Enterprises Inc. (1,979 shares). The filing is a routine registration of shares for resale, not a standalone special situation transaction. The resale is exempt under Regulation S. No new economic terms, premium, or board recommendation are disclosed. This is purely a securities registration event with no change in corporate control or special-situation dynamics to analyze.
